structured.answer: According to the page, the cheapest way is an account at Psagot (פסגות) buying the IBI fund for Tel Aviv 125 (5112628). It costs about 1,049 ₪ over ten years, versus about 4,500 at Leumi and 6,500–10,500 at the other big banks. I wouldn't act alone, though. I'd ask my son or the bank first.
